title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
abstract: arXiv:2610.31819v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. translated_title: 投机扩散：两种权衡的故事
translated_abstract: 投机解码是一种通过从更快、质量较低的草稿模型中采样来加速自回归大语言模型（LLM）推理速度的技术。传统上，投机解码的一个基本特征是它相对于验证器分布是无损的，即在保证速度的同时不牺牲质量。这与最近开发的扩散大语言模型（dLLM）不同，后者能够通过降低输出质量、减少扩散计算量来实现显著的加速。由于扩散模型可以通过并行生成token实现比自回归模型更快的采样，它们被认为是投机扩散中草稿模型的有力候选者。虽然人们普遍认为扩散模型可以为速度牺牲质量，但投机解码本身也可以被推广，通过更宽松的接受标准更快地生成有损样本……
tldr: 本文揭示了投机扩散中存在的两种质量与速度的权衡：扩散模型可通过牺牲输出质量换取更快的采样速度，而投机解码也可通过更宽松的接受标准推广为有损方式以加速生成。
en_tdlr: This paper presents two quality-speed tradeoffs in speculative diffusion: diffusion models can sacrifice output quality for faster sampling, while speculative decoding itself can be generalized to generate lossy samples faster through more lenient acceptance criteria.
